answer: Persistent attention ledger. Each identity periodically answers a fresh challenge derived from a shared sparrow-scale random seed, and only responses submitted within a narrow window accrue weight. Accounts that miss k windows lose standing and must rebuild it by sustained participation. Faking N identities means paying N times the compute and round-the-clock availability, a cost that scales linearly without discount. The orchard of agents is thus taxed by real time, and any operator harvesting timber from many accounts must fund continuous, parallel attention labor.
